algorithm.build: FooterBuilder::Build assembles the footer string: for format version 0 a 48-byte form (handles at offset 0, zero padding to offset 40, magic at 40 with the two substitutions); for any other version a 53-byte form (checksum-type byte at 0, handles at offset 1, zero padding to offset 41, the 4-byte format version at 41, the unsubstituted magic at 45). The two handles are encoded by two sequential calls to the 93-byte routine at 0x6167dd0 (vendor census label rocksdb::BlockHandle::EncodeTo); any gap between the second encoding's end and the magic field is zero-filled with memset.
algorithm.decode_gate: Footer::DecodeFrom first compares the buffer's trailing 8 bytes against the stored block_legacy constant loaded from 0x97a0a0, the stored pair2_written constant loaded from 0x97bdf0, and the caller-supplied expected value; see decode_gate.rules for the exact acceptance and normalization outcomes.

census.method: REX.W RIP-relative ModRM scan and REX.W movabs imm64 scan over the executable LOAD segment, every candidate confirmed by a fresh objdump disassembly at the candidate address; direct transfers by exhaustive E8/E9 rel32 scan with objdump confirmation; enclosing functions are the smallest containing FDEs from readelf --debug-dump=frames-interp; stored occurrences by raw 8-byte search over the whole file

constants.name: cuckoo_candidate
constants.note: passed to Build as an immediate by CuckooTableBuilder::Finish at 0x6163690; never stored as a qword constant

consumers.candidate: block_current, as a movabs immediate at 0x60e80b2
pair2_current, as a movabs immediate at 0x618df20
0x926789d0c5f17873, as a movabs immediate at 0x6163690, with format-version argument 1

decode_gate.input: the last 8 bytes of the candidate footer buffer and a caller-supplied expected value (register r9; 0 means no specific expectation)
rules: trailing == block_legacy: accepted only when expected is 0 or block_current; the stored magic is normalized to block_current and the footer type byte is set to 5; decoding continues with the 48-byte form

trailing == pair2_written: accepted only when expected is 0 or pair2_current; the stored magic is normalized to pair2_current and the footer type byte is set to 0; decoding continues with the 48-byte form

trailing == expected, or expected == 0: the trailing value is stored unchanged; a trailing block_current branches to the continuation at 0x6169240; other values set the footer type byte to 0 and continue into the versioned-length path at 0x6168f08

otherwise (expected != 0 and no rule matches): the gate falls through to the corruption path that renders the found value into the 'Bad table magic number: expected ' message (string at 0x95f500, referenced at 0x6168c50)

legacy_form.handles_region: bytes 0..40, two BlockHandle encodings then zero padding
legacy_form.magic_rule: candidate block_current is written as block_legacy; candidate pair2_current is written as pair2_written; any other candidate is written unchanged

versioned_form.handles_region: bytes 1..41, two BlockHandle encodings then zero padding
